android.desc:
Splity is the ultimate expense-sharing app that makes splitting bills with friends, family, and roommates effortless. Never worry about awkward money conversations or complicated calculations again!

✨ KEY FEATURES

📊 Smart Expense Splitting
• Equal Split - Divide expenses evenly among group members
• Custom Split - Set specific amounts for each person
• Percentage Split - Allocate expenses by percentage
• Usage-Based Split - Split based on actual consumption
• Category-Wise Split - Automatically split by member preferences

💰 Comprehensive Expense Tracking
• Create unlimited expense rooms for different groups
• Track expenses across multiple categories (food, drinks, transportation, accommodation, entertainment, shopping, utilities, and more)
• Add detailed descriptions and amounts for every expense
• View complete expense history with detailed breakdowns
• Real-time expense updates and calculations

👥 Group Management
• Create and manage multiple rooms for different occasions
• Invite friends and family with simple room codes
• Track who paid for what in each group
• See individual member balances at a glance
• Manage room members effortlessly

📈 Insightful Analytics
• View expense summaries and breakdowns
• Track spending patterns by category
• See who owes whom and how much
• Filter expenses by category, date, or member
• Generate comprehensive reports

💡 PERFECT FOR:
• Roommates sharing rent and utilities
• Friends splitting vacation expenses
• Couples managing shared costs
• Group dinners and outings
• Travel buddies on trips
• Event organizers tracking contributions
• Family expense management

Download Splity today and say goodbye to expense-tracking headaches forever!
